hook.text: You've held Apple since 2010. It's part of your identity now. Selling would feel like betrayal. That's attachment.

buildup.text: Emotional attachment to stocks creates an ownership bias—you overvalue what you own simply because you own it.

discovery.text: The endowment effect shows people demand more to give up something they own than they'd pay to acquire it.

twist.text: Attachment prevents rebalancing. Portfolios become concentrated in yesterday's winners instead of tomorrow's.

climax.text: Treating positions as rentals, not possessions, allows rational evaluation free from emotional weight.

punchline.text: Stocks don't know you own them. Don't get attached.

quiz.question: What is the endowment effect in trading?
options: Overvaluing what you own simply because you own it
